title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Advertising - Trade Names
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal decides to operate their practice under the trade name "Ontario Justice Adjudicators Paralegal Firm". Is this permissible under the Law Society of Ontario's Rules of Conduct?
options: Yes, paralegals may use any trade name they wish as long as it is registered with the government.
Yes, because the word 'Paralegal' is clearly included in the name.
No, because a trade name must not be misleading or imply a connection with a government or adjudicative body.
No, paralegals are strictly forbidden from using any trade names and must only practice under their legal name.
questions.explain: Under Rule 8.03, marketing and practice names must not be misleading, confusing, or deceptive. Using a name that implies a connection with a government agency, the Crown, or an adjudicative body (like "Ontario Justice Adjudicators") is strictly prohibited.
